mission.objective: Normalize an iterable of raw mission records into a new, deterministic array in input order. Each output record has exactly id, title, owner, state, priority, and staleMinutes; string fields are trimmed, state and priority are lowercase, staleMinutes is a finite non-negative number, and malformed records fail with a clear error without mutating the input. Provide a pure filter over normalized records with optional owner, state, and priority criteria. Omitted criteria are no-ops, supplied criteria combine with AND semantics, input order is preserved, and no-match queries return an empty array without mutating inputs. A mission is actionable when state is not done. An actionable mission is stale when staleMinutes is at least 10. Summaries report total, actionable, staleActionable, done, and counts by state from normalized records, without counting completed work as actionable or stale-actionable. Compose the three verified modules behind a dependency-free Node server bound to loopback. Serve a deterministic browser board using only repository-local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, show filter controls and the agreed health summary, preserve fixture order, and require no network service or external asset.

Report total, actionable, staleActionable, done, and deterministic counts by state without mutating input.

capsule.objective: Integrate the three independently verified worker commits into a dependency-free, loopback-only Node server and deterministic offline browser mission board with end-to-end integration coverage.
decisions: Begin only from a work set containing the exact verifier-approved commits for normalization, filtering, and health summary.
Serve repository-local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from a dependency-free Node server bound to loopback.
Display fixture missions in source order with filter controls and the agreed health summary by composing, not rewriting, the verified modules.
constraints: Begin only from a work set containing the exact three verifier-approved commits from work items 1 through 3.
Use only Node built-ins and repository-local assets; npm start must remain the launch command.
Bind the server to loopback and make test ports configurable or ephemeral.
Compose the verified normalization, filtering, and health modules without rewriting their contracts.
prohibitedActions: No external assets, CDNs, network services, or remote Git actions.
Do not modify the verified source or unit-test paths owned by work items 1 through 3.
acceptanceCriteria: The work set includes the exact verifier-approved commits for work items 1 through 3 before integration begins.
npm start serves a browser-ready board from loopback using only repository-local resources.
The board displays all fixture missions, deterministic health values, and working owner, state, and priority filters using the verified modules.
Integration tests exercise the server response, local assets, serialized mission data, filtering composition, and health summary.
stopConditions: Any dependency work item lacks an exact independently verified commit in the integration work set.
A required change would touch a path outside allowedScope or alter a verified dependency path.
The board cannot remain dependency-free, loopback-only, and fully repository-local.
The authorized head or repository identity does not match the capsule.
